issues.detail: Missing hierarchical top_module with a flop/mux submodule instantiated three times; contract only gives one 1-bit register/mux.
issues.spec_evidence: // You want to create a hierarchical Verilog design where a flipflop and 2-1 multiplexer are in a submodule, and that submodule is instantiated three times in this code.

issues.detail: Spec data width is 3-bit r/q; contract uses 1-bit r_in/Q and an extra q_in, with no 3-bit state or three bit-slices.
L-low feedback transform from S12 is absent; rule does Q_next=q_in instead of q_next={q[1]^q[2],q[0],q[2]} or corresponding wiring.
spec_quote "2-1 multiplexer" does not evidence Q_next=q_in; no verbatim S12 quote is supplied and uncertain=false.
spec_quote only covers "if (L) begin"; the assignment Q_next=r_in lacks verbatim quote support and uncertain=false.
q_in meaning is unconstrained: independent external mux data vs current-Q feedback changes L-low output.
issues.alternative: q_in is the current registered Q feedback and should not be an arbitrary external sample, so L=0 with q_in=1 should use current Q=0 and hold Q=0, not set Q=1.
